sourceNotes: 新增端口页，可查看监听端口、已建立连接、所属进程和网络速率，并结束占用端口的进程
本机 IP 查询支持本地接口与多来源出口对比
应用服务整合应用、Homebrew、启动项与服务
端口入口可放在工具侧栏、网络页或同时显示，并优化应用服务的工具栏和列表布局
修复 Homebrew 包与服务操作可能跨页并发的问题
修复录制等操作临时禁用截图置顶后，先前等待图片处理的置顶请求被意外恢复的问题

en: Add a Ports page to inspect listening ports, established connections, owning processes, and per-process network rates, and terminate processes occupying ports.
Compare local interfaces and public egress addresses from multiple sources, including IP.SB location, provider, and ASN details, while respecting address-hiding settings.
Bring apps, Homebrew packages, startup items, and services together in App Services. Manage the current user’s launch agents and Homebrew services; system items remain read-only.
Choose whether Ports appears in the tools sidebar, on the Network page, or in both places, and refine the App Services toolbar and list layout.

Prevent Homebrew package and service operations from running concurrently across pages, and clarify quit confirmations, preflight timeouts, and operations that may continue after XStats stops waiting.
Prevent a pending screenshot-pinning request from running after recording or another operation temporarily disables pinning.
